title: A DEER LEAVES A DEER CARCASS
why: His words of 2026-10-15: he killed a deer and it became a dead human. A shot deer left the same body container a fallen man leaves, so it drew as a man lying on his back, with a head, a coat and a hand, and the prompt read SEARCH BODY. It now draws as a deer carcass, a brown flank on its side with four stiff legs, a pale belly and the head down with its antler, and the prompt reads SEARCH DEER. The meat it holds, the search time and the footprint are unchanged, and a human body still draws as a man. Birds leave nothing, as before.
now: A shot deer now leaves a deer carcass, not a body.
